about_the_game:
A fusion of martial arts and roguelike dungeon crawling—build your fighter, master lethal techniques, create your own combo, and conquer the abyss with your fists alone.

Strike. Survive. Evolve.

Demo Version 0 lets you play through the "Initiation Stage".

Features

  • Tactical Turn-Based Combat with Combo Chains:
    Combine a variety of moves to conquer hordes of demons! Strike while defending. Parry while striking. Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. Each time you survive, you master a new art.

    -Spend ACT points to unleash moves and create custom combos tailored to your fighting style.

    -Land a Backspin Kick on a knocked-back enemy for massive bonus damage—discover synergies between your techniques.

    -Use various stances to turn the enemy’s turn into your opportunity. Deflect incoming strikes and counterattack with punishing precision.

  • Item Collection and Survival:
    A foot clad in steel boots delivers a powerful kick—but a hand holding the legendary holy sword won’t throw a punch. Food that restores HP may be the most valuable item in the dungeon... but don’t overlook those that enhance your abilities.

    Sometimes, wielding a weapon in one hand and kicking with the other can be your path to victory.
    Adapt your equipment and techniques to forge a battle style that is uniquely your own.

  • Experience the Story of a Karate Master:
    Thrown into the abyss as punishment, stripped of all but your fists, you must fight to survive. Encounter allies and enemies, beasts and threats, as you uncover the essence of martial arts and the eldritch truths.
detailed_description:
TGS2025

September 2025 — Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025!

Enjoy hands-on play on the show floor and take on our Boss Challenge.

November 2025 — Demo Ver. 1: Major Update Planned

  • In addition to the Intro Stage, you can play up to “Shodan”, the first of the five main stages.

  • Significant additions to ARTS (martial techniques) and skills.

  • New features revealed: the town hub, companions, and permanent upgrades.

Spring 2026 — Full Release Planned

Stay tuned!
